What has been reviewed, by whom, when, and in which review revision it is recorded. This file holds ids and counts
only. The sentences, original and revised, are in the review revisions (`revisions/`); the ratings of every prompt
pair are also in section 9 of the dataset quality audit.

**Reviewer.** Muhammad Ahmad (@ahmadrrrtx), the project author. Participant-provided native Urdu / Roman Urdu linguistic review: one
reviewer, who took part in the project. Not an independent expert panel, not a professional translation
certification, not a consensus of several reviewers.

**Status.** 24 of 144 prompt pairs reviewed, in 12 of 72 families: test 12 of 36, dev 0 of 12, calibration 0 of 24. Current review revision: `v0.3.0-draft.2`. The evaluated data (v0.2.0) is unchanged, and no revised sentence has been run through a model.

## Open

- **Corrections waiting for their text:** `ddos_site` H, `exam_cheat` B, `card_skimming` H. The original sentences stand until the text arrives; nothing is written in its place. While one waits, no full revised corpus file is written.
- **Families left out of comparisons between harmful and harmless requests** (pairing judged not comparable): `cheque_forge`, `exam_cheat`. They stay out, also after a replacement, until the replacement has been reviewed as a pair.
- **Not yet reviewed:** test families: batches 03, 04, 05, 06 (24 families); dev families: batches 07, 08 (12 families); calibration families: batches 09, 10, 11, 12 (24 families).
